authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, sections 5.2 and 5.4
authority.requirement: R2007 section-map capacities are 0xf800 for AcDbObjects, ObjFreeSpace, Handles and Classes; 0x1000 for RevHistory; 0x400 for Template; 0x800 for Header and AuxHeader; and 0x300 for AppInfo. AppInfo uses section encoding 1 and is not marked as compressed.

physicalProducer.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, locally authored one-LINE DXF converted to AC1021
physicalProducer.observation: The producer's section map uses the documented capacities, and its AppInfo page uses encoding 1 with equal compressed and uncompressed byte counts.

finding: The AC1021 writer previously applied the R2004 0x7400 capacity to almost all sections and compressed AppInfo with encoding 4. These values differ from the documented and independently witnessed R2007 profile.
change: Use the R2007 default and section-specific capacities for locally generated sections and emit the built-in AppInfo uncompressed with encoding 1. Explicit raw-section capacity overrides remain supported.

validation.physicalMap: The actual generated AC1021 file is decoded through the system pages and each mandatory locally generated section descriptor is checked for its literal capacity and encoding; AppInfo also requires equal compressed and uncompressed sizes.
validation.independentRead: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON reads the generated profile with all listed descriptor capacities, encoding-1 AppInfo and one LINE with endpoints (1,2,3) to (4,5,6). LibreDWG also reports its known diagnostic for the unnamed empty map descriptor.

independentConverter.input: Locally authored minimal single-LINE AC1021 scratch output with the earlier header/name corrections and this section profile
independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: Exit status zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input; no DXF was produced.
independentConverter.interpretation: The section profile correction is documented and witnessed, but it does not resolve the rejection.

limits: The profile and readback tests do not establish ODA whole-file compatibility or native semantics.
